## About
We're LMV Electric, an owner-operated electrical contractor right here on Bob O Link Rd in Mount Prospect. We do residential and commercial work, and we're licensed, bonded and insured.
Customers get to know Maggie, who walks people through permits and ComEd rebate paperwork, and her husband Lukasz, who does the installs. We keep our service area small on purpose, around Mount Prospect and nearby villages. Our motto is "Stay local and pay less."
We work to the National Electrical Code and to local village codes, and we give you the price before we start.

## Services
- Electric Vehicle Charging Station: EV charger installs, with help finding the right spot, getting permits and filing your ComEd rebate.
- Electrical Wiring, Panel Upgrade, Breaker: Wiring, panel upgrades and breaker work for your home or business.
- 220 V Wiring / Dedicated Lines: Dedicated lines for equipment and appliances that need them.
- Electrical for Addition, Remodel: Electrical work for your addition or remodel, done to code.
- Troubleshooting / Code Violation: We track down the problem and fix it, including code violations.
- Ceiling Fans/ Light Fixture Replacement: New ceiling fans and light fixtures, put in clean.
- Attic or Whole House Fan
- Bath Exhaust Fan

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for an estimate?
A: No. We'll take the time to understand what you need, talk it through with you, and give you a free estimate.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. We are licensed, bonded and fully insured.

Q: Can you help with permits?
A: Yes. We know the local codes, and if necessary we can help you with the permits.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We keep a small service area around Mount Prospect, including Arlington Heights, Buffalo Grove, Deerfield, Des Plaines, Elk Grove Village, Glenview, Northbrook, Palatine, Park Ridge, Prospect Heights, Riverwoods, Rolling Meadows and Wheeling. If you're outside that area, call us anyway and we'll see what we can do.
